decisions.reason: As a newly launched software plug-in line with its own webpage, it shows a stronger initial commitment and is still too early and relatively inexpensive to abandon while market feedback remains limited.

The digital twin service is only newly introduced and so far only lightly signaled on the website, but its upside is still uncertain enough that keeping the option open is preferable to an early exit.
Authentication and identity delegation fits recurring enterprise software demand, and with only one year of market exposure there is not yet enough negative evidence to justify withdrawal.
An open GIS development framework can be resource-intensive and was only briefly presented, so its drop risk is somewhat higher, but the firm would likely wait longer before closing this option.
The dedicated launch message for the GIS identity and access service suggests strategic relevance and early commitment, making continued market presence more likely than immediate abandonment.
